title: What’s in the bag
audience: Brand new junior golfers and non-golfing parents
teachingJourney: Understand the basics of golf equipment
Know how to get fitted for clubs

pages.title: A simple guide
pages.coreMessage: Welcome to your journey in junior golf! This guide will help you understand the essential equipment needed for golfing.

pages.title: Clubs in a golf bag
pages.previousPageBridge: This section shows what equipment is typically found in a junior golfer's bag.
pages.coreMessage: A golf bag commonly contains various clubs tailored for different shots.
pages.visualPurpose: Show an overview of clubs in a bag

pages.title: Woods, irons and hybrids
pages.previousPageBridge: Learn about the main types of clubs: woods, irons, and hybrids.
pages.coreMessage: Woods are for long-distance shots, irons for accuracy, and hybrids combine features of both.
pages.visualPurpose: Focus on the different wood and iron types

pages.title: Wedges and putter
pages.previousPageBridge: Next up, let's explore the wedges and the putter.
pages.coreMessage: Wedges help with short, high shots, while putters are designed for use on the green.
pages.visualPurpose: Detail the usage of wedges and putter

pages.title: Getting fitted
pages.previousPageBridge: Understanding your clubs is crucial, but getting fitted properly is equally important.
pages.coreMessage: Fitting ensures clubs match a junior golfer's height, strength, and swing style.

pages.title: Quick check
pages.previousPageBridge: Finally, let's recap what you've learned with a quick check.
pages.coreMessage: Test your knowledge about golf equipment.
